title: Social Media Platform with Paid Voting & Video Marketplace
category: Social Platform · Paid Voting · Video Marketplace
summary: A social platform for video sharing, creator contests, paid voting and marketplace advertising, built around engagement and monetization.
result: Paid voting and video-stream monetization built into a social platform
challenge: The platform needed social engagement features alongside a secure paid voting system and a monetization channel for video and feed advertising.
solution: Built social features for posts, video sharing and creator interaction.
Implemented contest voting with one free vote per user and additional paid votes.
Integrated Stripe and PayPal for purchasing additional votes.
Built a marketplace module for ad placements in video streams and post feeds.
Focused on performance, security and user engagement.
outcomes: Delivered a complete social publishing and interaction experience.
Created an additional advertising monetization channel.
